name: Til Barfi
instructions: 1. Dry roast the sesame seeds in a pan over medium heat until they pop and turn golden, then set aside.
2. In the same pan, heat ghee and add the jaggery, stirring continuously until it melts and reaches a soft-ball consistency.
3. Add the roasted sesame seeds, crushed peanuts, desiccated coconut, and cardamom powder to the syrup.
4. Mix thoroughly until the ingredients are well combined.
5. Transfer the mixture to a greased tray or plate and spread it evenly.
6. While still warm, cut the mixture into square or diamond-shaped pieces.
7. Allow the barfi to cool completely until it sets firm before serving.
description: Til Barfi is a popular seasonal delicacy in Jharkhand, traditionally prepared during the winter months and festivities like Makar Sankranti. It is cherished for its warmth, energy-giving properties, and the earthy, nutty flavor of sesame seeds combined with the richness of jaggery.
